## Scientific rationale

Explain the problem, assumptions, and why the change belongs in ChemPredict.

## Changes

List the affected data, model behavior, applicability rules, website behavior, or documentation.

## Validation

- [ ] Python unit tests pass.
- [ ] Public data/repository audit passes.
- [ ] Browser test passes when web, registry, artifact, or inference files changed.
- [ ] Model changes include grouped nested metrics, maximum error, and champion comparison.
- [ ] Data changes include provenance and redistribution permission.

## Boundaries

Describe any new failure mode, unsupported reaction class, uncertainty change, or safety implication.
